revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~2.4% was depressed by FX/refranchising; mid-single-digit organic growth fading toward 4% as pricing/mix and volume normalize.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941), FY2024 21.2%, FY2023 24.7%; 27% is a haircut to FY2025 which may include one-offs.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximates KO's long-run effective tax rate high-teens to ~20%; not taken from a tool; reviewer to verify vs 10-K tax note.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.67 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) unlevered cash-corrected 0.575, D/E 0.206, 21% tax) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US 2026-02-16) = CoE 7.8%; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran) after-tax ~4.2%; weights 83/17 (Damodaran industry D/E, no share price available) => ~7.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly nominal GDP-like long-run growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature consumer staples brand.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 45,436 (LT debt noncurrent 42,119 + current 1,822 + commercial paper 1,495) - cash 10,270 - short-term investments 3,602; 10-K 0001628280-26-010047. Note: tag may include finance leases.
